The iron ore stockpile (formerly known as the "ore cutter") is a construct used to store [[iron block]]s. It's required in order to later process these blocks at the [[stone cutter]] or [[stone cutter II]] into [[iron ore]]. It does not have any particular function of its own outside of this.

==Notes==
*Only 7 blocks of iron can be stored in a stockpile at a time.
*The one that can be built in the [[workyard]] is important, as the porter [[zombie]]s use it to deposit iron blocks mined near the [[cabin in the woods]].
